verdict.rationale: Payout scheduling and per-payout reconciliation are fair questions for a payment processor, so this axis applies. The pack shows no settlement or payout-schedule controls and no payout composition reports. The 'scheduled charges' item is about recurring customer charges, the supplier-disbursement item is outbound payments, and the refunds docs cover issuing refunds rather than reconciling them into payouts.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can control the payout schedule and see exactly which charges, fees, and refunds make up each payout
